davidk513: Day 9: Teodor Davidk reached Q-F9 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Teodor Davidk wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Teodor Davidk and Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. Grey Mill is lost. Teodor Davidk heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Teodor Davidk's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
fynn_witcombe: Jonas Witcombe signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at P-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Jonas Witcombe looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Jonas Witcombe checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F12 with the rations. Jonas Witcombe ate while listening to the revised orders.
On a quiet night Jonas Witcombe (Concord) and Ivo Racoon (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
grant.hemana: Pavel Hemana was a clockmaker in Dunmarrow until the posters went up. He came to R-S14 with a lock of hair in a matchbox, and within a day the whole squad knew that he writes everything down in a tiny notebook.
Pavel Hemana cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Pavel Hemana dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Matthias Universal coming out. It was over in seconds. (@chamra_universal) Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Pavel Hemana kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A round went through Pavel Hemana's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Bastian "Mud" Hi of the Hegemony (@hi691812). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Pavel Hemana answered to number 514. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Pavel Hemana wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A bullet struck Pavel Hemana below the ribs at R-S14. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Clement Hs of the Hegemony (@13_h.s_54). Pavel Hemana was killed on watch at R-S14. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Clement Hs of the Hegemony (@13_h.s_54).
Edmund "Button" Hemana joined R-S14 under the shadow of Pavel Hemana's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
hi691812: Bastian "Mud" Hi took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Bastian "Mud" Hi during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Bastian "Mud" Hi had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Pavel Hemana was grazed. Bastian "Mud" Hi saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-C11 and fired once. Clement Metropolitan was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian "Mud" Hi is number 881 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bastian "Mud" Hi shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The water jacket hissed as Bastian "Mud" Hi fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Oskar Elementalher was grazed.
internetmang: "You're late," said the corporal when Bram "Smokes" Internetmang arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Blackwater Canal has been won. Bram "Smokes" Internetmang listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Bram "Smokes" Internetmang felt a hard tug at his hip at R-R7. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Arno "Mud" Bobkin of the Concord (@bob.bobkin.921). Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bram "Smokes" Internetmang shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Bram "Smokes" Internetmang no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
lynallwarrior51: The draft reached S-S3 on Day 8. Karel Lynallwarrio was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Karel Lynallwarrio cut Marek "Lucky" Chase's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.

A bullet clipped Karel Lynallwarrio's helmet at S-S3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Otto Dunkmyanactu of the Hegemony (@dunkmyanactual). Karel Lynallwarrio did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Karel Lynallwarrio fired back. Yann Nilsiiboy was grazed. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S3, Karel Lynallwarrio listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Karel Lynallwarrio was hit in the foot through his boot at S-S3. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Gustav Foad of the Hegemony (@foad666x). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Karel Lynallwarrio fell at S-S3 and never moved again. Shot by Gustav Foad of the Hegemony (@foad666x).

Tobias Lynallwarrio joined S-S3 under the shadow of Karel Lynallwarrio's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. The clerk counted the names twice. Tobias Lynallwarrio is number 537 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Tobias Lynallwarrio looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Tobias Lynallwarrio in the open at S-S3. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Oskar Londonz of the Hegemony (@londonz_29). Tobias Lynallwarrio was killed outright at S-S3, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Oskar Londonz of the Hegemony (@londonz_29).
The House of Lynallwarrio sent Clement Lynallwarrio after Tobias Lynallwarrio. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
nothing_va1: "You're late," said the corporal when Valentin Nothing arrived on Day 11. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Valentin Nothing was promoted to Lance Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain. A letter from home reached Valentin Nothing before dusk. Valentin Nothing read it twice and slept a little easier.
ollie081224: Albin Ollie introduced himself as a brewer from Kesselby. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice. Victory at Grey Mill. Albin Ollie let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Albin Ollie found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
tacomeister: Nobody asked Nils "Mud" Tacomeister why he came. Nobody in Q-F23 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Pavel Emanvince and Nils "Mud" Tacomeister share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. A letter from home reached Nils "Mud" Tacomeister before dusk. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister read it twice and slept a little easier. The transfer made Nils "Mud" Tacomeister a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

A single shot from across the wire hit Nils "Mud" Tacomeister in the thigh at Q-F23. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Henrik Ami of the Concord (@ami_ne_dz13). A letter from home reached Nils "Mud" Tacomeister before dusk. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister read it twice and slept a little easier.
totally_geeked_fish: At the depot, Matthias "Brick" Fish had practised answering to his name. At S-C16, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

Matthias "Brick" Fish fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Tobias Adammyers was grazed trying to cross it. A bullet went through Matthias "Brick" Fish's sleeve at S-C16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian Noahz of the Concord (@702.noahz). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Matthias "Brick" Fish helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

A single shot from across the wire hit Matthias "Brick" Fish in the thigh at S-C16. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Isidor Jacksondeehr of the Concord (@jacksondeehring). A single shot at S-C16. Matthias "Brick" Fish sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Isidor Jacksondeehr of the Concord (@jacksondeehring).

Bastian "Shadow" Fish had heard about Matthias "Brick" Fish's courage. At S-C16, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian "Shadow" Fish is number 989 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Bastian "Shadow" Fish watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Roland Lovelightnin fixed the strap on Bastian "Shadow" Fish's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
totally_normal_ozzy: The sergeant gave Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 8 or any other.
Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon and Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it. A letter from home found Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy before the night shift. Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy answered to number 566. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy thought about a grandmother who prays for both armies on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
